privacy.intro: A plain-language summary. The full policy is published at the link in the app store listing.

stored.title: What we store
stored.body: Your email (via Clerk), the expenses, plans and fixed charges you enter, any receipt photos, PDFs or spreadsheets you upload, and, only when you turn on “Save my location” for an expense, the place where it was made.

ai.title: AI processing
ai.body: When you import a file or open a weekly/monthly recap, the relevant data is sent to our AI processor, TensorX (EU-hosted, zero data retention), to extract line items or write a short summary. Nothing is added to your expenses without your confirmation.

where.title: Where
where.body: Database on Neon and files on Amazon S3, both in Frankfurt (eu-central-1). Files are private and only reachable through short-lived links created for you.

reminders.title: Reminders
reminders.body: Reminders are scheduled on this device. We do not read your notifications.

controls.title: Your controls
controls.body: Edit or delete anything at any time. Deleting your account in Settings removes all records and files immediately.

noAds.title: No ads, no tracking
noAds.body: We do not sell data, show ads, or use advertising identifiers.
